title: Parametric Design Modeler
description: Represents a design as named parameters with valid ranges instead of fixed geometry, so an explorer can vary dimensions systematically instead of redrawing by hand.
architecture: Parameters drive a geometry kernel; changing a value regenerates the full model deterministically.

title: Pareto Front Ranker

architecture: Non-dominated sorting assigns Pareto ranks; crowding distance preserves diversity along the front.
acceptance_tests: The demo front contains no dominated designs and spans the mass-stiffness trade-off.
